name: fakecloud-poc
description: Proof of concept evaluating fakecloud as a local AWS stand-in: a production-shaped, event-driven app (Terraform, Lambda, SNS, SQS, DynamoDB, S3, Kafka, CloudFront, Route 53, Next.js) deployed and tested end to end on a laptop

scripts.build: npm run build -w @poc/core && npm run build -w @poc/functions && npm run build -w @poc/job-worker && npm run build -w @poc/web
